📖 How to use

❓ Frequently asked questions

      
Which browsers support glassmorphism?
It uses backdrop-filter, supported by all modern browsers. Safari needs the -webkit- prefix, which the generator includes automatically.
Why include a -webkit prefix?
The generator includes -webkit-backdrop-filter in the copied code so Safari renders it correctly.
Does the blur affect the text inside the card?
Yes — the card text stays crisp because the blur applies to the background layer behind the card, not the card contents.
